title: Superelliptic Affine Lie algebras and orthogonal polynomials II
summary: Let $\mathfrak{g}$ be a finite-dimensional complex simple Lie algebra and $r,m\ge 2$. The universal central extension of the superelliptic current algebra $\mathfrak{g}\otimes A$ is $\widehat{\mathfrak{g}\otimes A}\cong\mathfrak{g}\otimes A \oplus(Ω^1_A/dA)$, where $A=\mathbb{C}[t,t^{-1},u]/\langle u^m-(1-2ct^r+t^{2r})\rangle$. We compute the recursion relations governing a natural cocycle basis in $Ω^1_A/dA$ and encode them by generating functions admitting closed integral expressions of superelliptic type.
